title: What made Petit's band popular; Freddie Keppard
summary: He says Petit's band was together with good rhythm and he only just missed hearing Keppard in Chicago.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: What was it about Buddy's band that made it popular?
Well they just naturally had a good band. They was together. They had wonderful trombone player. Zebra Norris was good. Good rhythm. Buddy was a good trumpet.

It wasn't too loud. Remember now who the other trumpet player was? You said you could something, maybe something in the order of Louie and somebody else and you couldn't remember who the other one was. Freddie Kaplan.

You were just on records. I was around Chicago. I wanted to get a chance to hear him but I never did. He was working in the loop at that time. I was only there for a couple of days. I didn't get a chance to hear him.
But did he have much of a reputation?

Yeah. Yeah, he had 20% reputation. He had to build for an arrangement to build for an There are age people that can't do that now. Younger class, there are a few of them, you know, go for it. But the people that go for it, most of the people, you know, middle-aged people, yes. Those are the people that support it now.
